description: Implementation of NetworkStatusObserver class managing network connectivity status, security tokens, and event subscriptions within the WPEFramework plugin for TTS.

classes.name: NetworkStatusObserver
classes.description: Singleton class that observes network connectivity status and manages security tokens, notifying other components of connection changes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NetworkStatusObserver.

methods.name: getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves a security token, either from environment/config or via external token utility functions.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the device is connected to the internet, establishing the network service if necessary, and subscribing to status change events.

methods.name: onConnectionStatusChangedEventHandler
methods.description: Handles network status change events and updates internal connection state.
